a.lede: Travel routers simplify the process of connecting a half-dozen devices to hotel Wi-Fi, but they aren't necessary in simpler setups.
a.title: Do you really need a travel router? Here's what to know

b.lede: Most internet routers are solid out of the box, but that doesn't mean they can't be made more secure. Often, all you need to do is tweak a few settings.
b.title: How to improve your router's security in 10 minutes
